title: midnight-manual MCP prompts
description: MCP prompts exposed by `mnm mcp serve`. Implemented against the MCP prompts spec (2025-06-18). The runtime manifest lives at `crates/mn-mcp/src/prompts.rs::list()`; this document mirrors it.

add_advanced_search_skill.description: Install the midnight-advanced-search skill into this session's AI harness so the assistant uses the advanced retrieval playbook automatically. Checks whether it's already present and installs it if not, then tells the user how to reload. Surfaced to users as /mnm:add-advanced-search-skill (clients may namespace, e.g. /mcp__midnight-manual__add_advanced_search_skill).

arguments.name: harness
arguments.description: Optional comma-separated harnesses (claude-code, codex, opencode, cursor). Omit to auto-detect.

arguments.name: scope
arguments.description: Optional install scope: user (default) or project.

content.text: Instruction to call install_search_skill (forwarding harness/scope when supplied) and relay the per-harness reload step.
